items.title: Norway's Beat Spins Out Zedoc, a New Agentic AI Platform
items.excerpt: Zedoc, a new agentic AI metadata platform spun out of Norway's Beat Technology, streamlines publisher workflows: subject classification (Thema, BISAC, Dewey), accessibility enrichment, speech-to-text, ONIX record generation, audiobook chapterization, and structuring product data for AI-driven discovery.

items.title: Researchers to investigate local editor and publisher AI use
items.excerpt: University of Melbourne and RMIT researchers have launched a survey of Australian publishers and editors on how they actually use generative AI in their work, focusing on text-based LLMs across editorial and publishing practice.

items.title: Announcing a Course to Help Publishers Navigate the AI Age Responsibly
items.excerpt: A new four-week online program for publishing professionals aims to help teams understand AI technology, build practical AI workflow systems, and set organizational guidelines around usage and protection.
